explanation: It fires only at D1, about 9-10 when the previous trial was a1 that went rare to S2 and was rewarded (about 6 when that happened one step later in a run), and 0 if that rare trial went unrewarded. Otherwise it is 0 at every GO and D2 step and at nearly every D1; the one exception is a faint 1-3 at D1 after rewarded a2 trials during long a2/S2 streaks.
